channel.title: News | GATAS Lab
channel.description: Awards, degrees, placements and talks from the GATAS Lab.

item.title: Four lab members spend the summer at national labs and Georgia Tech
item.description: Andersen Wall at AFRL, Joana Bou Barcelo and Liam Kunzendorf at Georgia Tech, and George Rauta at ARL Adelphi.

item.title: Tyler Hanks and Luke Morris receive their PhDs
item.description: The lab's first two PhD graduates, both hooded in May 2026.

item.title: A Brazilian category theory hub, from Ben Bumpus's group
item.description: Categorias Brasil — a repository for all things category theory in Brasil, built by Ben Bumpus's student Paulo Vitor Macedo Dias.

item.title: George Rauta presents Decapodes CFD at WCCM–ECCOMAS
item.description: Low-Mach compressible Navier–Stokes on rectilinear grids, via discrete exterior calculus, in Munich.

item.title: Ben Bumpus is a professor at the University of São Paulo
item.description: A professorship at IME at the University of São Paulo, where he now leads the CUÍCA lab.

item.title: Wilmer Leal promoted to research scientist
item.description: Now a research scientist in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, with the Nonlinear Controls and Robotics group.

item.title: James Fairbanks named an ASEMFL Rising Star
item.description: The Academy of Science, Engineering and Medicine of Florida recognized James Fairbanks at its 2025 Annual Meeting.

item.title: A minisymposium at SIAM Mathematics of Data Science
item.description: James Fairbanks organized a minisymposium at MDS24 in Atlanta, with Tyler Hanks, Evan Patterson and Henry Adams speaking.

item.title: Kris Brown joins the Topos Institute
item.description: A research scientist at Topos since 2022, and still a maintainer of the AlgebraicJulia libraries.
